item.description: Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc. sales rose faster than expected in the third quarter, as more frequent menu launches and revamped loyalty offers help sustain a recovery that had been threatened by a food-illness scare. Bloomberg's Michael Halen joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
